{{Quote|Slaves who were planning to escape never lied about their intentions. Instead they stayed silent, even when they were beaten to death.|[[Perre Needmo]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>}}
A '''Silence oath''' was taken by [[Jessar]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] who intended to escape their lives of servitude and never lied about their plans. However, if and when they were caught, they instead chose to remain silent, even under pain of death.
